description: Multi-agent shared blackboard for asynchronous coordination. Actions: get (read notices or fetch by id), set (post notice with TTL), delete (remove by id or topic), lease (acquire or release mutex), list (list active topics). Legacy post/read supported.

agent_role.description: Sender agent role (e.g. planner, coder, reviewer).

id.description: Blackboard entry identifier for get or delete.

limit.description: Maximum number of items or topics to return.

mode.description: Lease action mode: acquire or release (default: acquire).

resource_id.description: Resource identifier to lease or release.

name: use_blackboard
